status: DRAFT - NOT YET APPROVED, NOT YET RUNNABLE
_comment: The IMPROVEMENT pilot declaration for skillc#287 (orchestrator review, comment 6025311708, decisions P1-P6). Exploratory only: estimates the CPP and baseline pilot pass rates that evals/calibration-287/power_simulation.py's choose_n() needs to size the main study - it draws NO verdict (operator ruling, comment 6021089903: 'No verdicts are drawn from the pilot. Its record must say so.'). This file DOES fit skillc.calibration.parse_declaration's existing matched-outcome shape unmodified - a literal 'baseline' arm with a null subject, one treated arm ('intact', the CPP subject) - so no schema change is needed for THIS declaration. See pilot-discrimination-declaration.json for why its sibling does NOT fit that shape and is therefore a different 'kind'.

pilot.purpose: exploratory - estimates p_hat_intact and p_hat_baseline for evals/calibration-287/power_simulation.py's choose_n(); draws no verdict
pilot.no_verdict_statement: This pilot draws no IMPROVED / NO_IMPROVEMENT_SHOWN / UNKNOWN verdict. Its 10 attempts per arm are too few to be the predeclared improvement test itself (that test is the MAIN study's declaration, sized by this pilot's results) and are never pooled into the main study's counts (P1).
rule_citations: P1 (comment 6025311708): pilot attempts never count toward the main study.

P2 (comment 6025311708): the pilot uses the same two-declaration shape, one pilot declaration per test, each 2-arm at n=10, each separately approved at 10. The intact arm therefore runs in both pilot declarations (see pilot-discrimination-declaration.json's 'intact' arm, same subject).

P3 (comment 6025311708): this pilot's own raw proportions (passes/evaluable) must never be plugged into the sizing simulation directly - convert with evals/calibration-287/power_simulation.py's jeffreys_estimate() first.
P5 (comment 6025311708): tolerance is max(1, ceil(0.05*n)) per arm, not a flat 1.
P6 (comment 6025311708): arm order is calibration's seed-derived interleaving, so the two arms run interleaved in time rather than as two blocks.

task._comment: Per the operator's improvement ruling (claude-power-pack#1084 comment 6014163660, cited verbatim in skillc#287 comment 6014179807): 'on the same task, grader and pinned subject revision as the case that #273's pairing record certifies as discriminating'. skillc#270 is open and uncertified as of 2026-10-06 (checked directly); this declaration cannot be finalized until it names a real path/grader_id/grader_revision.

arms.name: intact
arms.treatment: the cpp-codex-flow-check-ea6dbfa profile installed, unmodified (skillc#265/#330, merged 841689b; skillc profile diagnose/validate both report 0 problems at this pin). The SAME subject as pilot-discrimination-declaration.json's 'intact' arm - this is what P2 means by 'the intact arm runs in both pilot declarations': one subject identity, two separate 10-attempt pilot schedules, never shared attempts (attempt-sharing was explicitly declined, comment 6025311708).

arms.name: baseline

tolerance.rule: max(1, ceil(0.05 * attempts_per_arm)) = max(1, ceil(0.5)) = 1 at n=10 (P5)
